test_navigate_to_maps.title: Verify the Maps page loads with the site dropdown visible

steps.action: Click Maps in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Maps page opens and shows the site dropdown at the top.

test_select_site.title: Verify selecting a site from the dropdown loads map cards

steps.action: Click Maps in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Maps page opens with the site dropdown.

steps.action: Open the site dropdown and pick the configured site.
steps.expected: The dropdown shows the chosen site and at least one map card appears below it.

test_map_cards_have_cameras.title: Verify at least one map card has cameras (device count > 0)

steps.action: Click Maps in the left sidebar, open the site dropdown and pick the configured site.
steps.expected: The site's map cards appear, each with a device count.

steps.action: Read the device count on the cards.
steps.expected: At least one card shows a device count above zero.

test_open_map_with_cameras.title: Verify clicking a map card opens it and shows camera icons

steps.action: Click Maps in the left sidebar and pick the configured site.
Click a map card whose device count is above zero.
steps.expected: The map opens and camera icons are placed on it.

test_play_online_camera.title: Verify clicking an online camera icon plays its stream without failure

steps.action: Click Maps in the left sidebar, pick the configured site, and open a map card that has cameras.
steps.expected: The map opens with its camera icons; an online camera shows a green icon.
The camera's live stream starts playing and no "failed to load" message appears.
